notes.title: Exhibitor Information at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.content:
[p]Frontier Works Inc. will be showcasing two 2025 releases—[i]The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition[/i] and [i]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/i]—at Tokyo Game Show 2025, hosted at Makuhari Messe from September 25 - 28, 2025![/p][p]Both games will be exhibited at the Frontier Works Inc. booth, where attendees can experience firsthand the charm and creativity that define each title.[/p][p]To commemorate the event, [i]The Aquarium does not dance Special Edition[/i] is now on sale! Don’t miss your chance to grab it at a discount, just in time for the spooky season![/p][p]
[b] ◆ Event Dates[/b]
September 25 (Thu) – September 28 (Sun), 2025

[b]Business Days:[/b] September 25 (Thu), 26 (Fri); 10:00 - 17:00 JST
[b]Public Days: [/b]September 27 (Sat); 9:30 - 17:00 JST, September 28 (Sun); 9:30 - 16:30 JST

[b] ◆ Venue:[/b]
Makuhari Messe Halls 1 - 11 + International Conference Hall + Event Hall

notes.title: Release Date Postponed
notes.content:
[p]Frontier Works Inc. has revised the release date of their upcoming title, [i]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/i], to focus on improving the quality of the release. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Updated Release Date: Wednesday, October 8, 2025[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]We understand this is disappointing news for players eager for the release, but we appreciate your patience and understanding as we focus on releasing a polished product. In the meantime, we will continue to provide updates on the game’s content.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Heroic Songs: the Remix! Story Open
notes.content: [p]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/p][p]✨ Here’s a little taste of the story ahead of release! ✨[/p][p]Akari Sunohara, a passionate idol otaku, gets a wee bit emotional after watching her oshi’s concert. We’ve all been there. No judgement. 👀[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="LRFetss-CIY;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Worldbuilding and Design
notes.content: [p]Let’s explore the isekai worlds within Heroic Songs: the Remix![/p][p][/p][p]🌿 F[b]antasy-style isekai: Seven Falls[/b][/p][p]This divine beast-themed region appears early in the game. Unlock recipes for charming, old-world buildings like the “Theater” and “Quarry”! 🐲[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/df942f1ac1749770c1e6f4ab96cf8cc2f55d43a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]☔ [b]Sci-fi themed isekai: Discordia[/b][/p][p]This is the “World of Mechanized Harmony.” Unlock blueprints for industrial buildings like “Safe Food Factory” and “Motel.”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/cb861332a79ede6e25c228818e9442c9ca75c434.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🌸 [b]Japanese-style isekai: Karan Ashihara[/b][/p][p]This elegant “World of Harmony” offers the chance to unlock building recipes for charming locations like “Treasure Ship” and “Candy Shop”![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/6ac927c49fbb5fb136d7d4e3623cb5350a626a72.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Akari Sunohara Character Design Rough Draft
notes.content: [p]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/p][p]Here’s a sneak peek at #AkariSunohara’s rough design![/p][p]Her lead-character look—perfect for a story-driving protagonist—was illustrated by the talented Lows ✨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/fa73e44af3b2ec4196e2413a99b6b2eb5d50aff3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Introducing Character Part 2
notes.content: [p]✦✦✦✦✦✦✦[/p][p]An Idol × City-Building Simulation Game...[/p][p]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/p][p]✦✦✦✦✦✦✦[/p][p]Let’s meet the supporting cast who stand alongside our idols![/p][p][b]● Moku-san[/b][/p][p]A flower-headed man who claims to be the spirit of Yggdrasil, deep within the Void. Though his appearance is a bit suspicious, he’s a reliable guide for both city-building and interworld travel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/161cb420de9cedde760e995823ef0e22682ca632.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]● Kroschel Singulant[/b][/p][p]A swordsman from the fantasy isekai of Seven Falls, and Lynalelle’s older brother. Though sharp-eyed and rough around the edges, he’s a kind-hearted man who helps govern the kingdom alongside his sister.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/73e06770d02d3806d0e5ccf404fe00dce3c327bf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]● Doctor Kluk[/b][/p][p]A scientist from the sci-fi isekai world of Discordia. He provides technical support for Haru, the mechanical songstress. Despite his eccentric appearance, he’s a good-natured genius who selflessly uses his knowledge to benefit the world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/71405f6f703d98974ba49f16ff5d808301fb6b64.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]● Shin[/b][/p][p]A libertine from the Japanese-style isekai world of Karan Ashihara. A mysterious young man with connections everywhere—from performing arts and religious ceremonies to politics. With his easygoing charm and boundless energy, he becomes Akari’s cheerful guide to idol life in Ashihara.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/651a9d3205fc256c75f7eef0f2fbdaba4db3b52e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Introducing Character Part 1
notes.content: [p]✦✦✦✦✦✦✦[/p][p]An Idol × City-Building Simulation Game...[/p][p]Heroic Songs: the Remix![/p][p]✦✦✦✦✦✦✦[/p][p]Introducing the five main idols of the story![/p][p][/p][p][b]● Akari Sunohara[/b][/p][p]Just an ordinary girl who loves idols. She holds the gift of becoming an "idol" who can restore resonance between worlds, and begins performing to find her way back to Earth from the Void. Though she’s initially hesitant and struggles with self-doubt, her encounters with senior idols from other worlds—and the support of her fans—spark her growth.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/0c1147f34e99ee8aab88fb19632dc17dba5c80ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]● Ruri Tsukuyomi[/b][/p][p]The “ultimate idol” who reigns supreme with a breathtaking voice and overwhelming stage presence. Traces of her can be found across various isekai worlds. She’s also Akari’s absolute oshi, and her presence echoes throughout many key moments in the story.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/3e239e1343c2bca6e686e25515cc4b96c5f55033.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]● Lynalelle Singulant[/b][/p][p]An idol from the fantasy-style isekai world of Seven Falls. She’s not only royalty and an idol—she’s also a passionate idol otaku. The first veteran idol Akari meets, Lynalelle becomes her friend as they overcome trials together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/82aa12e0b5c1a8b1a0bc6e3b9a43f6f007fe8fe6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]● Haru[/b][/p][p]An idol from the sci-fi isekai world of Discordia. A hero who liberated humanity, Haru now stands as a beacon of hope. She becomes a trusted mentor to Akari—but her status as a savior also carries hidden burdens.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/073e8892dc191b7ea009560195d90b24907f3f39.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]● Kaguya[/b][/p][p]An idol from the Japanese-style isekai world of Karan Ashihara. Also known as the wrathful Behemoth of Befoulment, Kaguya appears before Akari as a formidable rival. She harbors intense feelings toward Ruri, which seem to fuel her hostility toward Akari… or are her motives not what they seem?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699141/534d20e7d1be1548d1fae67a8bdbc0fdd499bbb9.jpg"][/img][/p]
